{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are systematically too high, especially in early horizons, showing negative forecast bias that corrects toward mean-reversion in longer horizons",
    "Sentiment positively correlates with price level but has muted effect on forecast deviations",
    "1-7 day ahead forecasts show largest systematic errors compared to 8-15 and 16-30 day forecast patterns",
    "Price level matters: model bias is larger at higher price levels (above 72 EUR) than at lower levels",
    "Sentiment turning from positive to negative predicts better than model would indicate",
    "Model under-forecasts price declines more than it over-forecasts increases at all horizons",
    "When sentiment is negative, true outcomes are closer to model forecasts than when sentiment is positive"
] }
